entityTypes.name: subject
entityTypes.description: One animal (juvenile Wistar rat (p18-p24)). The data descriptor: 'The data are organized by subjects (animals). All the data recorded from the same subject are collected in one folder (named by cell type, subject number and date of recording).'

entityTypes.name: recording
entityTypes.description: One ABF file: one protocol applied to one granule cell. The data descriptor: 'The protocol applied in each case is indicated in the filename. If more than one cell was recorded from different slices cut from the same subject, different prefixes (A/B) were used to indicate the different cells.'

subject_id.name: subject_id
subject_id.title: Subject number
subject_id.description: Two-digit subject number from the folder name <celltype>_Subject<NN>_<ddMMyy>.

recording_date.name: recording_date
recording_date.title: Recording date
recording_date.description: Date of recording from the subject folder name, written ddMMyy. The file names carry the date too, but drop leading zeros in some files, so the folder is read.

protocol.name: protocol
protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: Protocol named in the file name, lowercased: CC step (2 s current steps), IV (from -70 mV) and EPSP (mossy fibre stimulation, 5 pulses at 50 Hz).

dataLocations.description: Tognolina et al., whole cell patch-clamp recordings of cerebellar granule cells (dataset version 7dc5d5d5-4323-41d6-bdfd-0b841cfe7000). One folder per animal, <GrC>_Subject<NN>_<ddMMyy>, holding one ABF file per recording; the data descriptor and the licence at the root. The data descriptor names a root folder 'PatchClamp-Granule cells/', a file HBP_DataDescriptor_PatchGrCs.txt and a licence 'Licence (CCBY-SA).pdf'; the bucket has no such folder, and has HBP-DataDescriptor_PatchGrCs.txt and 'Licence (CCBY-NC-SA).pdf'. Every entry of the bucket was listed.
